title: Sensitive Data Detection and Classification in Spanish Clinical Text: Experiments with BERT
answer_short: BERT achieves state-of-the-art performance on NERC-like tasks and strong results in anonymisation tasks on Spanish clinical text, especially when fine-tuned.
answer_rationale: The evidence indicates that BERT performs well on anonymisation tasks in Spanish clinical text, with comparisons to other models and mentions of fine-tuning approaches. Specifically, Text 2 states that BERT has shown outstanding performance in NERC-like tasks, improving state-of-the-art results for almost every dataset and language. Text 1 confirms that BERT was used as a base for sequence labelling in anonymisation tasks on Spanish clinical text, with comparisons to other systems. Text 3 further supports this by noting that BERT-based models, including those with CRF layers, achieve competitive results, with one implementation scoring 3 points lower than the current approach, implying strong performance. Text 4 reinforces BERT's general success in NLP tasks, including NERC, which supports its effectiveness in the context of anonymisation.
